cohort: High-risk women with projected poor obstetric outcomes who underwent robotic-assisted transabdominal cerclage for obstetric indications.
finding: Robotic-assisted transabdominal cerclage significantly increased the odds of delivering after 34 and 37 weeks gestational age (4.0 and 3.6 times greater, respectively) and improved neonatal survival (12.6 times greater) compared to prior pregnancies.
